title: ViLFlow: Parallel Vision-Language Generation with Continuous Latent Flows
abstract: arXiv:2611.24240v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language generation has predominantly relied on autoregressive and discrete diffusion models. Autoregressive models generate tokens sequentially, while discrete diffusion models typically predict tokens independently within each denoising step. We propose ViLFlow (Vision-Language Flow), a continuous-flow vision-language model that combines joint modeling of output embeddings with parallel token decoding. ViLFlow adapts pretrained continuous language generation to visual question answering and image captioning through learned image guidance and prediction-aware token decoding. A visually adapted teacher provides image-guided predictions as additional denoising supervision. The denoiser learns to reproduce these predictions directly, retaining one image-conditioned prediction per generation step. We train the token decoder on denoiser predictions and paired reference text to improve the conversion of continuous outputs into words.

translated_title: ViLFlow：基于连续潜在流的并行视觉-语言生成
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言生成领域目前主要依赖自回归模型和离散扩散模型。自回归模型按顺序逐个生成token，而离散扩散模型通常在每个去噪步骤内独立预测token。我们提出ViLFlow（Vision-Language Flow），一种连续流的视觉-语言模型，它将输出嵌入的联合建模与并行token解码相结合。ViLFlow通过学习到的图像引导和预测感知的token解码，将预训练的连续语言生成模型适配到视觉问答和图像描述任务中。一个经过视觉适配的教师模型提供图像引导的预测，作为额外的去噪监督信号。去噪器学习直接重现这些预测，从而在每个生成步骤中保留一个以图像为条件的预测。我们在去噪器的预测结果与配对的参考文本上训练token解码器，以改进从连续输出到文字的转换。
tldr: 提出ViLFlow，一种结合输出嵌入联合建模与并行token解码的连续流视觉-语言模型，通过图像引导的教师预测和预测感知解码，将预训练连续语言生成模型高效适配到视觉问答和图像描述任务。
en_tdlr: ViLFlow is a continuous-flow vision-language model that combines joint modeling of output embeddings with parallel token decoding, adapting pretrained continuous language generation to visual question answering and image captioning via image-guided teacher predictions and prediction-aware token decoding.
